northstar-leave.md: Fictional Northstar Labs leave policy. Full-time employees receive 20 vacation days per calendar year. Up to 5 unused vacation days carry over until 31 March of the following year. Submit leave requests in the HR portal for line-manager approval. Sick leave is separate from vacation leave.
northstar-expenses.md: Fictional Northstar Labs expense policy. Submit itemized receipts within 30 days of the expense. Expense claims above INR 5000 require manager approval. Business travel must be approved before booking. Submit claims through the expense portal.
northstar-employment.md: Fictional Northstar Labs employment policy. The notice period for full-time employees is 30 calendar days. Discuss the final working date with your manager and HR. Complete equipment return and the handover checklist before departure.
